turns.question: Who spent more per order in September 2026, our Turkish or our Dutch customers, and what was their average?
turns.answer: Turkish customers spent slightly more per order in September 2026 (1-30 September): EUR 109.64 on average per non-cancelled order, against EUR 109.45 for Dutch customers. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
